$comment: Finance server rules. Edit here — no code change needed. dataDir is relative to mcp-academic/ and is DELIBERATELY not data/sample: the academic server loads every CSV of its own dataDir (query_table), so money data placed there would be readable through the academic server. Override with env FINANCE_DATA_DIR. Teachers, sections and conduct come from the academic data dir (teachers.csv, sections.csv, conduct.csv).

calendar.$comment: Same calendar as config/utility.json: month (1-12) -> semester number; the academic year starts in academicYearStartMonth. Used to turn a payroll month into a semester.

tuition.$comment: Data-quality check: amount_due must equal credits_registered x fee_per_credit x (1 - discount_pct/100) within this tolerance.

scholarship.$comment: GPA and conduct thresholds live per scholarship in scholarships.csv (min_gpa, min_conduct). These switches add the two other conditions. 'No owed course' = after the best attempt per course up to the semester, no course is still failing.

teaching.$comment: pay = base_salary (payroll.csv) + periods x rate(title) + overtime bonus + bonus - deductions. periods = sum of sections.periods of the teacher in the month's semester x weeksPerMonth. Overtime bonus = periods above standardPeriodsPerMonth x rate x overtimeBonusRatio.
